title: QuaternionType
description: A quaternion representation of a 3D rotation: a scalar (real) part w and a vector (imaginary) part x, y, z. The schema does not enforce unit length; normalization is the concern of the downstream math implementation.

w.description: The scalar (real) component of the quaternion.

x.description: The x component of the quaternion's vector (imaginary) part.

y.description: The y component of the quaternion's vector (imaginary) part.

z.description: The z component of the quaternion's vector (imaginary) part.
